title: Ancient Rome
description: A whole pub quiz about ancient Rome: emperors, legions, gods and the city itself.

questions.prompt: According to legend, which twin brothers founded the city of Rome?
Which animal is said to have suckled those twin brothers?
Who became the first emperor of Rome?
What was the large open square at the heart of Roman public life called?
Which great amphitheatre in Rome was built for gladiator fights?
Which structures did the Romans build to carry fresh water into their cities?
Which river flows through the city of Rome?
Which volcano buried the city of Pompeii?
What was the Roman army unit of several thousand soldiers called?
What was the officer who commanded about eighty legionaries called?
Who was the king of the Roman gods?
Which Roman god of war gave his name to a planet?
Which Roman goddess of love is the counterpart of the Greek Aphrodite?
Which Carthaginian general crossed the Alps with war elephants?
What was the council of leading citizens that governed Rome called?
What was the draped woollen garment worn by Roman citizens called?
What were the armed fighters who performed in the arena called?
Which wall across the north of Britain is named after a Roman emperor?
Which drink did the Romans usually mix with water before serving it?
Which language did the ancient Romans speak and write?
In which year was Julius Caesar murdered?
Which river did Caesar cross in 49 BC to march on Rome?
Which battle decided the war between Octavian and Mark Antony in 31 BC?
Which Roman road ran from Rome south to the port of Brindisi?
Which emperor made Christianity legal in the Roman Empire?
In which year did the western Roman Empire come to an end?
Which building in Rome has a huge dome with a round opening in the middle?
Which Roman goddess guarded the eternal flame in the heart of Rome?
Which Roman poet wrote the Aeneid?
Whose victory column in Rome shows the wars against the Dacians?
On how many hills is Rome traditionally said to be built?
In which year AD did Vesuvius bury the city of Pompeii?
Roughly how many spectators could the Colosseum hold?
questions.explanation: Estimates run from fifty to eighty thousand; fifty thousand is the figure most often given.

questions.prompt: How many aqueducts supplied the city of Rome at the height of the empire?
How many days did the year have in the calendar of Julius Caesar?
questions.explanation: His reform of 46 BC gave the year 365 days with a leap day every fourth year, and it stood for sixteen centuries.

questions.prompt: In which year BC was Rome founded, according to tradition?
How many letters did the classical Latin alphabet have?
How many kilometres long is Hadrian's Wall?
Name the four emperors who ruled Rome in the year AD 69.
Name the four Julio-Claudian emperors who came after Augustus.
Name the four Roman gods matching the Greek Poseidon, Hades, Athena and Demeter.
Name the four months of our calendar that are named after Roman gods.
Name the four colours of the chariot racing teams of Rome.
Name the four Roman numerals that stand for 50, 100, 500 and 1000.
Name the four Roman provinces covering what are now Spain, France, Britain and Egypt.
Name the four towns buried by the eruption of Vesuvius in AD 79.
